items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: my good friend from way back, William Smith, who was known as "Smittie" and who had changed his name to Smyth.

ctx.x: My father and sister had moved from West 9th street where they were living when we went to Cincinnati in 1954. They were now living in Walnut Hills on Rockdale Avenue. My old buddy, Eddie Partridge and his wife Mattie, who was a cousin of mine lived in the same house as my father and Eddie and myself had some drinking good times.

My brother, his wife, an uncle and cousin John Coleman also lived on the hill and not too far from my father. We gave a party, my brother gave one and many of his or his wife's friends gave parties and that's the way our visit to Cincinnati was spent most of the time. My old boss Clarence Page also invited us to his house as did my good friend from way back, William Smith, who was known as "Smittie" and who had changed his name to Smyth. He was a union delegate and still playing piano in clubs. Clarence Page waa…

We spent a few days in my brother's home and one day we decided to visit my Uncle Ernest Coleman, who did not live far from my brother. As we were a mixed married couple, trouble could be around any corner and it was around one this day. We were not far from my brother's place when it started to rain but not hard. One of my brother's step daughters was with us and we sent her back to the house to get an umbrella.
